We need to determine number of aromatic carbon atoms in the compound. But we have no description of the compound. Possibly the system expects we retrieve NMR spectra and infer aromatic carbons? But we don't have SMILES. Maybe the sample is "at hand" meaning there is a compound loaded in environment. We can get carbon NMR spectra which will list peaks, maybe indicate aromatic region (~120-150 ppm). Could count number of aromatic carbons.

We can call carbon_nmr_spectra tool.
